subject.title: Bug: OpenClaw 2026.4.9 exposes agent internal thinking (English) to user

question: Should the attribute-bearing thinking-tag leak be repaired through a maintainer/security-owned core sanitizer change now, instead of waiting for the broader reasoning-default or inter-tool text leak trackers?
rationale: The source gap is narrow and reproducible, but the item is security-sensitive and already carries no-new-fix-pr plus needs-security-review labels, so automation should not open an unsponsored fix PR.

options.title: Security-owned core repair
options.body: Approve a focused core sanitizer repair that reuses the shared grammar for embedded streaming and validates streamed attribute-bearing tags without changing broader reasoning defaults.

options.title: Fold into broader leak policy work
options.body: Defer this narrower sanitizer repair into a broader reasoning/channel leak project, accepting that the concrete streaming attribute gap remains open until then.

recommendation.title: Security-owned core repair
recommendation.body: Approve a focused core sanitizer repair that reuses the shared grammar for embedded streaming and validates streamed attribute-bearing tags without changing broader reasoning defaults.
